function.name: bash
function.description: Run a bash command with the repository as the working directory. Use it to search (grep -rn, find), inspect, and run tests or scripts. Non-interactive only; times out after 180s. Returns combined stdout/stderr and the exit code.

function.name: read_file
function.description: Return the contents of a file with line numbers. Paths are relative to the repository root. Returns at most 400 lines per call; use start_line/end_line (1-based, inclusive) to page through larger files.

function.name: grep
function.description: Search file contents with a regular expression (ripgrep if available, else grep -E), skipping .git, node_modules and vendor. Returns file:line:text, at most 100 matches. Prefer this over grep in bash.

path.description: File or directory to search (default: repository root).

glob.description: Only files matching this name pattern, e.g. *.py

function.name: glob
function.description: List repository files matching a pattern, e.g. **/test_*.py or src/**/*.go (tracked and new files, not ignored ones). At most 200 results.

function.name: edit_file
function.description: Replace an exact string in a file. old_string must match the file exactly (including whitespace and indentation) and occur exactly once; include enough surrounding lines to make it unique. To create a new file, pass an empty old_string and the full content as new_string.

function.name: repro_check
function.description: Register a reproduction check: a shell command (usually running a script you wrote under /tmp) that exits 0 when the issue is fixed and non-zero otherwise. The command is run immediately and its output returned. All registered checks are re-run automatically when you call done.

function.name: todo
function.description: Your requirements checklist. Early on, add one item per requirement, interface item (exact name, signature, file location, message) and edge case in the task, plus one item 'existing tests for the changed code pass'. Mark an item complete only with evidence: the command you ran and what it showed. An item is met only as worded: keeping the old behaviour through an alias or wrapper does not meet a requirement to change it. Items cannot be deleted; drop one with a reason if it turns out not to apply. `done` is refused while items are open. Every call returns the whole checklist.

complete.description: Number of the item to mark complete.

drop.description: Number of the item that does not apply.

evidence.description: Required with complete (how you verified it) or drop (why).

function.name: find_tests
function.description: Find the existing test files that cover a source file, and how to run them. Hidden tests are usually added to these files, so read and run them. For a new file, lists the tests near it and whether the test runner there is configured.

path.description: A source file, relative to the repository root.

function.name: done
function.description: Declare the task finished. Call only after the fix is applied and verified. Refused while a registered check fails, a checklist item is open, or the working tree has no changes. An independent reviewer may then check your diff against the task once and send back what it finds.
